# README preview assets

The main README links to existing project images in their original folders. These additional previews fill gaps without modifying the source projects:

- `umap.png`: final embedded PNG output from `tutorials/data-analysis-and-machine-learning/umap/UMAP.ipynb`, extracted without alteration.
- `gsr-to-umap.png`: final embedded PNG output from `tutorials/data-analysis-and-machine-learning/gsr-to-umap/03_Audio to UMAP.ipynb`, extracted without alteration.
- SVG files: schematic workflow identifiers, explicitly labelled “WORKFLOW OVERVIEW”. They are not screenshots or claimed project outputs. Replace them with representative project captures when those become available.

Keep README preview links relative so they work on GitHub and in downloaded copies. When adding a resource, add it under its topic in the main README with a short description and a preview.
